items.text: Limits and epimorphisms of big sheaves

A sheaf on $\mathrm{Sch}/S$ = ordinary sheaves $F_{S'}$ on each $S'$, morphisms $F_{S'}\to f_*F_{S''}$ for $f\colon S''\to S'$, and $F_{S'}|_{S''}=F_{S''}$ for $S''\subset S'$ open. Limits and colimits are computed on each $F_{S'}$.
F\to G\ \text{epimorphism in }(\mathrm{Sch}/S)^{\sim}\iff F_{S'}\to G_{S'}\ \text{epimorphism for all }S'
For all $U'$, $g\in G(U')$: there is a covering $U'=\bigcup U'_i$ with $g|_{U'_i}\in\operatorname{im}\bigl(F(U'_i)\to G(U'_i)\bigr)$.
For $X\to Y$ schemes: $\widetilde X\to\widetilde Y$ is an epimorphism iff $X\to Y$ admits local sections over $Y$.
A family $F_i\to G$ is epimorphic iff each $g\in G(U')$ locally comes from some $F_{i(\alpha)}(U'_\alpha)$.
A sheaf $F$ is a scheme iff there are subsheaves $F_i$: (a) $F_i\to F$ open immersion, (b) $\{F_i\to F\}$ epimorphic, (c) $F_i$ representable (by affines).
Representability is local on the base: $S=\bigcup S_i$ open, $F_i=F\times_SS_i$ representable for all $i$ $\Longrightarrow$ $F$ representable.
Projective bundle of a quasi-coherent module
P(\mathcal M)(S')=\{\,\mathcal M_{S'}\twoheadrightarrow L : L\ \text{invertible}\,\}\qquad(\text{a Zariski sheaf; it is a scheme})
Reduce to $S$ affine: $\mathcal M=\sum\mathcal O_Se_i$, $V=\Gamma(S,\mathcal M)$.
P_i(S')=\{\,\mathcal M_{S'}\twoheadrightarrow L : \dot e_i\ \text{is a basis of }L\,\}
(a) $P_i\to P$ is open: the set where a section of an invertible sheaf is a basis is open.
(b) $\mathcal M_{S'}$ generated by the $e_i$ $\Rightarrow$ $L$ generated by the $\dot e_i$ $\Rightarrow$ locally one of them is a basis.
